title: Copy phase of the unary machine
statement: For all natural numbers $c,C$, every Boolean word $x$, and every natural number $i\le |x|$, after $i$ steps the unary machine with parameters $c,C$, started on $x$, is in its copy state with empty output, input-head position $i+1$, every one of its $c+1$ work heads at position $i$, and each work tape containing true exactly at the integer positions from $0$ through $i-1$.
